programs.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Mardi Gras, Rock Candy, Dentures"
programs.desc: A look at how the amazing, and massive, decorations on Mardi Gras carnival floats are created, how rock candy is twisted together, and a look at how dentures are made.

programs.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Helmets, Tea, District Heating"
programs.desc: How do they harvest and treat the world's most expensive tea? Plus, how does the Siekierki power plant of Warsaw, Poland heat half the city's homes?

programs.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Royal Enfield, Art Fraud, Milk"
programs.desc: How do they engineer the latest incarnation of the classic Royal Enfield Continental GT motorbike? Plus, how do 'art detectives' spot a forgery?

programs.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Crash Testing, Delftware, Umbrellas"
programs.desc: How do they blend science and destruction at crash test centres? And how do they piece together the complex mechanism of a pocket sized umbrella?

programs.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Stories from Space"
programs.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli visits each astronaut, including Story Musgrave, the only astronaut to fly aboard all five space shuttles, and Anna Fisher, one of the first American females to go into space.

programs.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Second Annual Student Astronaut Contest"
programs.desc: Going aboard a Zero-G aircraft where they’ll experience microgravity with host, Emily Calandrelli.
